name: Asou Shiori
source:
A nurse who began working at “Date Clinic” on Reimi’s recommendation. She had previously worked alongside Hitomi at her former hospital.

When the protagonist confronts her about her relationship with Hitomi, he exploits the situation and subjects her to training as a “comfort nurse.”

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130303161514/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/r3/char.html]archived official site[/url]]
